text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to the magnificent new world. 
Kicking fate aside, victorious is the God 
of Destruction who governs the split 
second!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My beloved archrival, I shall never forget 
this bloody battle. Let us compete again 
and again, even if the world spins for 
billions of cycles.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The march of the God of Destruction who 
rules the fleeting moments will not stop! 
To show this planet my brilliance! Let us 
advance! To the Japan Cup!
